---
title: "Methods and reproducibility"
---

## Experimental contract

Every real experiment must have:

- one immutable `EXP-NNNN` identity;
- a falsifiable hypothesis and null;
- treatment, controls, and fixed variables;
- declared metrics, sampling, exclusions, budget, acceptance, and stop rules;
- exact model, dataset, environment, tool, and code revisions;
- separate lifecycle, evidence, and outcome state;
- raw transition records and artifact hashes;
- a complete compute ledger, including aborted allocations.

## Reproduction levels

Artifact execution, directional reproduction, mechanism reproduction, and confirmatory replication are different claims. Reports must name the achieved level.

## Regulation-decision provenance

Control-decision traces distinguish fixed experiment assignment, external rules,
separately prompted modules, explicit primary-model output, human override, and unknown
source. Missing confidence, override, fallback, or planning fields remain unavailable.
Ordinary reasoning prose is retained raw and is not evidence of latent internalization.
The planned/deferred RQ-H2K surface is infrastructure-only and does not alter EXP-0001.

## Publication boundary

This static site executes no notebook code and has no model/cloud credentials. Generated status and experiment pages are projections of canonical repository YAML, not separately edited summaries.
